summary: Automation editor: the Runs tab (subject search, state chips, ↑ ↓), the run on the graph of its version with runOverlay (passed / failed / running / waiting / skipped, taken edges, attempt and item badges, failed-branch notes), 2 s polling of live runs, the node drawer (input, output, filtered logs), Cancel / Retry / Resolve for operators, and the Dry run (decision modes, captured effects, failed trigger condition) and Test node (confirmed irreversible effects, missing secrets) panels. EditorApi gains runs, run, version, cancelRun, retryRun, resolveRun and dryRun decisions; EditorProps gains automationId, can, runsView/onRunsView, subjectHref, onStartRun, connectionName. The graphs RPC adds automations.runs subject search, automations.dry_run decisions, catalog node idempotent/dry_run, the node of a wait, subject_url (graphs.Config.Links) and the /automations/runs/{run} link. Run steps keep what call nodes log (engine.Log, masked; migration adds automation.steps.logs); dry runs report each failed trigger's condition, cached decisions (status cached) and live_calls; node tests take an idempotency key claimed in automation.node_tests (a repeat on any process gets the stored answer; one without an answer — or past the day its answer is kept — is refused as outcome_unknown, never run again; the call key is test:<key>); automations.run returns the run's event projected for the viewer, failing closed (an event or field no rule can check is left out); automations.runs filters by node and automations.run takes nodes (StepsOf: the latest step of each named node beyond the detail's bound); a stored field whose type changed carries no old nested data; the automations module registers subject links (core.user → /users/<id>, WithSubjectLink) for subject_url and run contexts.
